subject.title: fix(infra): bound stalled provider JSON/text/binary response reads with default chunk timeout

question: Should provider response-body idle timeouts inherit the resolved provider/request budget, or remain fixed helper-level ceilings independent of models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds?
rationale: Both policies eliminate indefinite reads, but they encode different operator contracts and can change existing long-timeout provider behavior; repository evidence does not authorize automation to choose that product boundary.

options.title: Inherit provider budget
options.body: Thread the resolved request/provider timeout into body reads and use bounded fixed fallbacks only when no explicit budget exists.

options.title: Accept fixed ceilings
options.body: Land the 30-second success-body and 10-second error-body limits as independent policy with explicit documentation and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Make callers choose
options.body: Expose the timeout options without shared defaults and require each provider transport owner to select its idle budget.

recommendation.title: Inherit provider budget
recommendation.body: Thread the resolved request/provider timeout into body reads and use bounded fixed fallbacks only when no explicit budget exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion routes the shared provider-helper contract decision to this likely area owner, while the other candidates provide adjacent implementation and operator-contract history.
